title: Lower City Pass

sources.role: Rules: Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders
sources.title: Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders
markers: | description = Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders is a Quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Sister Yannis in the Open Hand Temple.

summary: Show this pass at Wyrm’s Crossing South Span to proceed to Wyrm’s Rock Fortress and the Lower City via North Span.

fields.Acquisition: Valeria gives it at Sharess’ Caress after Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders.
fields.Base value: 14 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
